title: Bug 640098: Make Table Information Cache refresh resilient to duplicate table numbers
summary: The Table Information Cache refresh now aggregates metrics when duplicate table numbers are encountered instead of failing with a duplicate-key error. This makes the Data Administrator page's refresh action resilient to orphaned or renamed SQL tables.
key_points: Fixes the Data Administrator Refresh action failing with a duplicate-key error
The platform's Table Information table can return several rows with the same Table No. but different table names
Instead of inserting a duplicate, the refresh now adds No. of Records, Size, Data Size and Index Size into the existing cache row
The full refresh no longer aborts with NavCSideDuplicateKeyException
